newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to announce first B Band winners soon-Motta.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to announce first B Band winners soon-Motta.

text.p: Brazilian Communications Minister Sergio Motta said winners of the first two B Band cellular telephone concessions would be announced in the next few days and the contracts signed by mid-June.
The first contracts for areas one and seven should be signed in the first half of June, Motta told reporters.

Area one corresponds the city of Sao Paulo while area seven covers the center-west region including Brasilia and the Amazonian states of Acre, Rondonia and Tocantins. A total of ten regional concessions are being offered to private consortia.
The minister also said bid specifications for cable television concessions would be published in the next 20 days.

Motta was speaking at a news conference at which he denied a report that he was involved in an alleged cash-for-votes scam. A ministry spokesman later denied rumors that the minister subsequently offered his resignation.
